user.title: Sign in
user.description: Enter your phone number to request a verification code.

verification.title: Verify account
verification.description: Enter the code sent to {account}, or select Resend code.

gates.title: Bind gates
gates.description: Select gates across communities. Each selection creates a device and an opening button. Saving does not open any gate.

abort.wrong_account: Sign in with the original account.
